programmes.programName: Doctoral Program of the Department of Management Science and Technology
programmes.evidence: Official Management Science and Technology department homepage links its doctoral programme; opened programme page states approximately 55 students currently registered and describes live doctoral research. The qualifying term is in the official host department title; Logistics/Transportation examples are not recast as formal specializations.
limitations: The page does not name a separately awarded Management Science degree; degree is the department-hosted doctorate.

branches.conclusion: The official Department of Management Science and Technology runs its own doctoral programme. This is one department-hosted route; individual thesis field labels are not duplicated as programmes.
Other university doctoral departments have not been fully screened for additional named Operations/Industrial Engineering programmes.
